rule: Current authority where explicitly listed
Accepted replay event/state through the stated history clock; may be reopened only explicitly
Accepted planning band; future realization remains replay-dependent
Accepted interpretation until dedicated closeout refines it
Current planning/result; may move with dedicated closeout
Future condition/decision; not a completed event
Highest-priority next item; not yet closed
Unresolved; do not silently choose a branch
Never auto-import into canon/OOB/losses
Physically exists; does not imply accepted/service-released/assigned/ready/combat-present
Factory/arsenal accepted; does not imply service release
Eligible for normal unit use; does not imply theater assignment
Allocated to a unit/theater; does not imply ready
Mission-ready at the stated time
Actually present in a replayed combat event
Ordered to withdraw; not yet concentrated/transported/reassigned
Moved into withdrawal concentration area; not theater-exited

Engineering/planning range; not a direct combat multiplier or exact observed value
Engineering/design/qualification possibility after current replay date; not actual history until a later replay/procurement layer realizes it
Historical fact/measurement used as constraint; worldline result may differ only through explicit causal change
Formal branch peace is in force from 1941-05-20; historical post-May China campaigns do not auto-occur
Never use popular aggregate shorthand instead of unit/date transfer data
Raw 1939 casualty delta is modest; main global channel is 1941 eastern threat perception and force-transfer timing
Ordinary petroleum/DEI trade, premium avgas/TEL controls, asset freeze and broader embargo are separate policy levers
V16 Grade A/B/C doctrine retained; avgas shortage does not equal GT/diesel fuel absence
Later layers supersede older current authority only on subjects they explicitly close/reopen
V20 main replay clock is 1942-08-31 24:00
No Pearl Harbor/Malaya/Philippines/DEI war has occurred by V20 clock; historical Pacific-war events require worldline triggers
United States remains formally nonbelligerent through V20 clock; no historical 1941-12-11 German declaration
Ordered/moving/arrived/integrated/ready are distinct; 1942-08-24 two-division order does not equal 21 ready divisions on 31 Aug
Use unit/date/sector transfer ledger; Japanese fixation affects which units can move, not all eastern forces equally
Separate objective FACT from intelligence ESTIMATE, leader BELIEF, PLAN-INPUT and PUBLIC-LINE
